package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/scheduler"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workercontrol"
)

type probeResult struct {
	Dispatched  bool      `json:"dispatched"`
	SQLState    string    `json:"sqlstate,omitempty"`
	Error       string    `json:"error,omitempty"`
	IntentID    uuid.UUID `json:"intent_id"`
	AttemptID   uuid.UUID `json:"attempt_id"`
	JobID       uuid.UUID `json:"job_id"`
	WorkerID    uuid.UUID `json:"worker_id"`
	WorkerEpoch int64     `json:"worker_epoch"`
	LeaseFence  int64     `json:"lease_fence"`
	LeaseToken  string    `json:"lease_token,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	internalPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer internalPool.Close()
	schedulerPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer schedulerPool.Close()
	coordinator, err := workercontrol.NewService(ctx, internalPool, workercontrol.Config{
		LeaseTTL:         2 * time.Minute,
		ActiveLeaseKeyID: "lease-key-v1",
		LeaseKeys: map[string][]byte{
			"lease-key-v1": []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeFailure(err)
		return
	}
	service, err := scheduler.NewService(schedulerPool, coordinator, scheduler.Config{
		SchedulerID:       os.Getenv("VELA_SCHEDULER_ID"),
		ClaimTTL:          30 * time.Second,
		CandidateAttempts: 1,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeFailure(err)
		return
	}
	dispatch, ok, err := service.RunOnce(
		ctx,
		uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_POOL_ID")),
	)
	if err != nil {
		writeFailure(err)
		return
	}
	result := probeResult{Dispatched: ok}
	if ok {
		result.IntentID = dispatch.IntentID
		result.AttemptID = dispatch.Assignment.AttemptID
		result.JobID = dispatch.Assignment.JobID
		result.WorkerID = dispatch.Assignment.WorkerID
		result.WorkerEpoch = dispatch.Assignment.WorkerEpoch
		result.LeaseFence = dispatch.Assignment.LeaseFence
		result.LeaseToken = dispatch.Assignment.LeaseToken
	}
	writeResult(result)
}

func writeFailure(err error) {
	result := probeResult{Error: err.Error()}
	var postgresError *pgconn.PgError
	if errors.As(err, &postgresError) {
		result.SQLState = postgresError.Code
	}
	writeResult(result)
}

func writeResult(result probeResult) {
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
